failure_mechanisms: HiGHS infeasibility is raised as generic RuntimeError; an all-zero customer instance gives c·weights=1 infeasible and has no dedicated diagnostic.
Negative candidates are only Fraction(limit_denominator(1000000)) approximations; no exact gamma feasibility, integer scaling, SPE replay, or dual certificate is checked.
Numerical slack near zero is subject to floating tolerances; no timeout/complexity bound and complete-tree enumeration grows exponentially.
Nonexistent output parent raises FileNotFoundError only after a negative slack is found; NumPy/SciPy imports and five-level ROOT layout are prerequisites.
